text:
alex: quick question — i'm going to add a GH Actions check that runs `kustomize build` + `kubeval` on `overlays/*` before atlantis plan runs. want to make sure we don't accidentally expose secrets or double-plan PRs. thoughts?

(tl;dr: validate manifests, block atlantis until validate passes, and ensure argocd-sync waits for apply to finish)

taylor: sounds good. where do you want the action to run? repo root or each overlay? can we do one job that loops?

alex: single job at repo root that iterates overlays; cheaper and easier to cache. will bail if any `kustomize build` fails.

prateek: watch out for secrets kustomize generators — some overlays use `secretGenerator` referencing files in `ci-secrets/` which are only populated in CI. kustomize build will error locally for contributors. consider using `--load-restrictor none`? or better: use `kustomize build --enable_alpha_plugins`?

jamie: another approach: run `kustomize build` with a small stub secrets directory checked into the repo (non-sensitive) for lint step. real secrets only injected in atlantis runner during apply. keeps lint stable for external PRs.

alex: yeah +1 for stub files. i don't want to run anything that needs vault access in lint step. only structural validation.

infra-bot: [atlantis] queued apply for #321 on `infra/main` — waiting on CI checks.

sally: on duplicate plans: if gha triggers on both push and pull_request we often get two plans. set `paths: ["infra/**"]` in the workflow and `if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'` for plan job. also add `concurrency: group: ${{ github.ref }}; cancel-in-progress: true` to reduce overlapping runs.

devin: for the gate between validate and atlantis plan, simplest is to have the validate job set an output `manifests_ok=true` and use a `workflow_run` or a required check context that atlantis checks. but atlantis itself cannot wait on GH Actions unless we gate at PR protection level.

prateek: what about adding a small `atlantis` GH Action that POSTs to the atlantis server only after success? we already have an `atlantis/apply` job; move the `atlantis plan` trigger behind validate. keep plan on PR still but make plan job `needs: validate-manifests`.

alex: proposing this step (very rough):
```yaml
jobs:
  validate-manifests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - run: |
          for d in overlays/*; do
            kustomize build $d | kubeval --ignore-missing-schemas || exit 1
          done
  atlantis-plan:
    needs: validate-manifests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: ./scripts/trigger-atlantis-plan.sh
```

jamie: looks fine. just ensure `kubeval` supports CRDs we use; add `--kubernetes-version` or provide CRD schemas in repo. otherwise we'll get noisy false positives.

alex: good call — i'll add `crd-schemas/` and a small readme.

prateek: one more: argoCD sync ordering. we currently have a webhook that triggers argocd after atlantis apply succeeds. to avoid race where argocd tries to reconcile before all images/configs are in place, add a tiny step post-apply to wait for a specific k8s condition or check the helmrelease status (if using flux). for argocd add a `sync-wave` annotation or use AppProject hooks.

sally: if we can't change argocd config easily, a simple retry loop in the webhook that waits for manifest hashes to match can work. but make retries exponential and with a cap.

devin: also add a test job that runs `helm template` / `kustomize build` and then a lightweight `kubectl apply --server-dry-run=client` against `kind` or `k3s` to catch runtime validation issues. optional but catches more than kubeval.

alex: plan: i'll open a PR with the GH Actions workflow + `crd-schemas/` + stub secrets and a short script `scripts/trigger-atlantis-plan.sh`. tagging @prateek @taylor for review. i'll also add documentation in `infra/README.md` about the new checks and how to run locally.

prateek: ack, will review once PR is up. can you also drop sample outputs in the PR so reviewers don't need to run the job?

alex: yep, will paste a successful `kubeval` run and explain stub secrets.

jamie: thanks — + :thumbsup:

alex: rough ETA: PR by end of day tomorrow. if anyone wants to pair on the argoCD sync part LMK.

prateek: ping me if you need help wiring the atlantis token for the action.

alex: thanks — will do.
